[[File:Hadios_Geks_TIE_Interceptor.jpg|thumb|250px|Hadios Gek's [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]]]
'''Hadios Gek''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Gek held the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] and patrolled the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] in a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]].<ref name="SWG:Cs" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hadios Gek appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Cs" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Major Hadios Gek was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:Cs" />
